B2.lemma: A cyclic quotient of a single 2^n-cycle has order dividing 2^n, hence no odd-order (>1) cyclic quotient at any binary level. Dynamical lift: binary odometer has no 3-cyclic clopen partition (eigenvalue e^{2pi i/3} absent); its H-orbit misses every basic open requiring a 3-factor. Corrigendum: v5's 24-atom 'U3 witness' used the 2-6-24 tower (a 3-factor odometer), NOT the binary tower, so it did not witness a binary-level open; the valid finite shadow is the divisor fact + 2^n mod 3 table (log4).
